info.title: Jordanian Digital Heritage Platform API
info.description: The core layer of the Jordanian Digital Heritage Platform. Protected content is served as watermarked tiles only; OCR text is internal and never returned.

post.description: Send a one-time code to the number (ACC-1). Three an hour, a minute apart.
Confirm the code; a verified phone raises the member's verification level (ACC-1).

get.description: The user's open readers and the sign-in each belongs to (SEC-5).

schema.title: Response List Content Works  Name  Content Get
Response List Own Grants Access Grants Get

post.description:
Ask for a watermarked, low-resolution PDF of pages within the session's grant. The
caller presents both credentials, the signed-in token and the session's grant token; the
request is logged with its page numbers and counted against the grant's quota.
A single-use download link that expires in fifteen minutes (SEC-15).

get.description: The PDF, once. The token in ``t`` is the credential; the file is deleted after this.

Unified search over works and page text. Page hits carry regions on the scan for
pages the caller may see, and never the text itself (SRCH-1 to SRCH-4, CAT-4).
